description: This file contains the implementation of a tuned blocked bloom filter (BlockedBloomFilter class) within the Orleans.Runtime.Placement.Repartitioning namespace. The class provides methods for creating, adding items, checking containment, and resetting the bloom filter, with specific tuning for false positive rates and performance optimizations.

classes.name: BlockedBloomFilter
classes.description: A tuned version of a blocked bloom filter implementation that supports adding elements and checking for their presence with configurable false positive rates.

methods.name: BlockedBloomFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the bloom filter with specified capacity and false positive rate, performing validation and regression calculations.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an element identified by GrainId to the bloom filter.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if an element identified by GrainId is probably in the bloom filter.

methods.name: RegressFpRate
methods.description: Calculates the adjusted false positive rate based on polynomial regression coefficients.

methods.name: GetBlockIndex
methods.description: Determines the block index within the filter array based on the hash value.

methods.name: ComputeMask1
methods.description: Computes the first bitmask for a given hash.

methods.name: ComputeMask2
methods.description: Computes the second bitmask for a given hash.
